description: This topic covers prominent national and international trophies, cups, and tournaments associated with various sports. It is a crucial section of Static General Knowledge for competitive exams, heavily focusing on direct mapping questions.

sections.title: Major Cricket Trophies
sections.description: Important domestic and international tournaments associated with the game of Cricket.

key_associations.extra_info: It is a domestic first-class cricket championship played in India between multiple teams representing regional and state cricket associations.
The most prestigious and historic Test cricket series played fiercely between England and Australia.
A domestic cricket tournament in India played annually between the incumbent Ranji Trophy champions and the Rest of India team.
A domestic first-class cricket tournament played between teams representing geographical zones of India.
A prestigious List A cricket competition in Indian domestic cricket, named after Prof. D. B. Deodhar (the Grand Old Man of Indian cricket).

sections.title: Major Football Cups and Trophies
sections.description: Key global and domestic competitions associated with Football (Soccer).

key_associations.extra_info: It is India's and Asia's oldest domestic football tournament, established in 1888.
A premier state-level national football championship contested by regional state associations and government institutions in India.
The most prestigious international men's football championship, held every four years.
The main international football competition contested among the men's national teams of South America (CONMEBOL).
A famous international inter-school football tournament held annually in New Delhi, India.

sections.title: Cups of Hockey and Badminton
sections.description: Prestigious international and national cups related to Field Hockey and Badminton.

key_associations.extra_info: One of the oldest and most prestigious field hockey tournaments in India.
An annual international men's invitational field hockey tournament held in Malaysia.
The premier men's international team championship in badminton, often referred to as the World Men's Team Championships.
The premier women's international team championship in badminton (World Women's Team Championships).
The biennial world mixed team badminton championship which takes place every two years.

sections.title: Cups of Tennis, Golf and Other Sports
sections.description: Prominent global trophies for Tennis, Golf, Table Tennis, and Polo.

key_associations.extra_info: The premier international team event in men's tennis, widely known as the 'World Cup of Tennis'.
Formerly known as the Fed Cup, it is the premier international team competition in women's tennis.
A biennial men's golf competition contested between teams from Europe and the United States.
Awarded to the winner of the Men's World Team Table Tennis Championships.
Conducted in India, it is considered the first and oldest polo trophy in the world.

sections.title: Historical Sports Events
sections.description: Crucial historical timelines marking the inception of major sports cups.

historical_events.significance: Started in Shimla by Sir Mortimer Durand, it remains the oldest existing football tournament in Asia and the third oldest globally.
Hosted and won by Uruguay, this event marked the beginning of the most watched sporting spectacle in the world.
Donated by Sir George Thomas, the inception of this cup played a vital role in globalizing and standardizing professional badminton.

sections.title: Exam-Oriented Important Facts
sections.description: Crucial one-liner facts and direct mappings frequently tested in competitive exams.

important_facts.fact: India created history by winning the prestigious Thomas Cup (Badminton) for the very first time in May 2022, defeating 14-time champions Indonesia.
The Dhyan Chand Trophy is a prominent national-level lifetime achievement award and tournament strictly associated with Field Hockey in India.
The Wellington Trophy is a highly esteemed championship associated with the sport of Rowing.
The Rovers Cup was a major football tournament held in India, started by British football enthusiasts in Bombay (now Mumbai) in 1891.
The Walker Cup is a renowned golf trophy contested in odd-numbered years between leading amateur golfers of the United States and Great Britain & Ireland.
